fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Well, well. If it isn't young Patch. You've lost something, lad.

fluff_intro.speaker: patch
fluff_intro.text: My tail? Oh, that. I lost it wrestling a thunderstorm. Two thunderstorms, actually. They were twins.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Mm-hm. I was on the Weather Page that night, you know. I saw what I saw.

fluff_intro.speaker: patch
fluff_intro.text: Ha! Ha. Anyway! Why is everything so... squelchy?

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: The Sogg. It's unfolding the meadow, one hill at a time. The windmills have stopped, and my flock is swelling up like sponges.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Pull the tabs, lad. The book still remembers how it's meant to fold. Up ahead, the old platform tab should still work.

fluff_repeat.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_repeat.text: Mind the Soggies. A good swipe dries them right out.

fluff_repeat.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_repeat.text: And Patch? Whatever happened that night, nobody here thinks less of you.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Hello. I am Dot. I end sentences.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Was. My sentence got smeared. Now I just float. Badly.

dot_meet.speaker: patch
dot_meet.text: Well, you're in luck! You've found the bravest fox in all of Foldwick.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Hm. Fine. I will come. Somebody has to end your sentences.
